data.description: Charau-ka are masters of thrown weapons. All charau-ka gain Throw Anything as a bonus feat. In addition, a charau-ka gains a +1 racial bonus on all thrown weapons, and their threat range for thrown weapons is doubled, as if the charau-ka possessed the Improve Critical feat for all thrown weapons. This effect doesn't stack with any other effect that expands the threat range of a weapon.
